title: भारत — विधान सभा निर्वाचन क्षेत्र (राज्य विधान सभा क्षेत्र सूची, 2008 परिसीमन)
description: Authoritative list of the 4,125 State Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) constituencies of India as established by the 2008 Delimitation Commission order. Each Assembly Constituency (AC) elects one Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) to the corresponding state assembly. Records include the parent Parliamentary Constituency (PC), so the table doubles as a PC→AC hierarchical mapping. Compiled by DataMeet from Election Commission of India (ECI) source records.
